svg.title: Eclipse Atesor architecture
svg.desc: main.py checks the URL, the recipe cache and the API key, and starts the riscv64 sandbox. A cache hit writes the recipe and stops. Otherwise the LangGraph state graph runs init_node, analyst_node (LLM) and heuristic_plan_node, or scout_node (LLM) when there is no default plan. supervisor_node routes by rules: to the build_fix_subgraph (build_node, verify_node, fix_node with an LLM) and back, to finish_node (LLM) on success, or to escalate_node at a limit. With --optimize, cached_recipe_node reuses a verified plan and optimize_node (LLM) tries faster tunes. A verified port goes into the memory, and the recipe cache uses it on the next run.
